status: implemented and tested in the local candidate patch; inactive inventory proposal

interface.output: Normal checks emit JSON on stdout; argparse help and usage output are separate.

statuses.0: reference check succeeds, or argparse help is requested

specDraft.title: Validate OpenSpec reference integrity
specDraft.description: The local reference checker SHALL resolve current declared scenario, source, candidate and external references against their specified inputs. It SHALL require supported schema versions as integer 1 and refuse nonstandard JSON constants. It SHALL return a nonzero status for a broken reference or malformed input. The result SHALL leave verification authority unassessed and coverage incomplete.

scenarios.name: Current references resolve
scenarios.when: the selected snapshot and pinned product source satisfy the supported reference profile
scenarios.then: the checker returns status zero with referenceIntegrity true, verificationAuthority not-assessed and coverageComplete false

scenarios.name: A declared reference is broken
scenarios.when: an active scenario does not belong to its named requirement or source evidence differs from its required bytes
scenarios.then: the checker reports referenceIntegrity false and exits nonzero

scenarios.name: A JSON input uses an unsupported format
scenarios.when: a versioned document supplies a schema version other than JSON integer 1 or a consumed JSON input contains NaN or either signed infinity literal
scenarios.then: the checker reports referenceIntegrity false and exits nonzero

boundary: No source locator or shipped claim for this candidate at the product pin. Parent review and any later inventory integration are separate.
